raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the source sends a reversal as a separate REVERSAL record pointing to orig_txn_id, and the original stays POSTED. silver_transactions only drops originals marked REVERSED, so the 15 reversed originals are still counted and gold totals run high. The old convention excluded reversed originals entirely, so I exclude each original that a REVERSAL points to. The REVERSAL rows are already filtered out by status = 'POSTED'.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
